items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: Ron Ryan. Yeah, you should have been.

ctx.x: That's the same... In the 40s. 40s. Same year I was in New York. Ron Ryan. Yeah, you should have been.
Jimmy Ryan. I never met him, but I remember when I was there in 19... I was there exactly in 1940, and they said, John Morera lives up the Red Alive where he was. Oh, yeah.
